messages:
Maya (partnerships): Quick heads-up — running a HW + SI stitching preflight for the marketplace launch. Need final alignment on landing page flow, partner badge/legal blurb, SI runbook handoff, and press timing. Who can own the cutover rehearsal slot?
Arjun (product): I can own landing hero & CTAs. Can we lock the hero by EOD Fri? Need partner-approved quote for the top banner.
Lena (PR): Embargo window proposed: Mon Apr 14 09:00 PT. Draft press release is in Drive: https://drive.redwood/release-drafts. We need Nimbus + EdgeWorks partner quote by Thu COB.
Tom (eng): Updated integration checklist posted in the repo. Key items: OAuth client exchange, tenant provisioning webhook, billing meter events, and SI onboarding API. Sample config:
```
# tenant-provision.yaml
oauth_client_id: redwood-marketplace
provision_webhook: https://staging.redwood/api/v1/provision
meters: [tokens_generated, embeddings_units]
```
Diego (solutions): For SI runbook: we need 2 test tenants with sample data + a failover scenario doc. Who can provision those? Also need screenshare rehearsal for SI onboarding.
Maya (partnerships): @Tom can you provision 2 staging tenants by Tue morning? @Diego schedule a 30m dry run with the SI leads. I'll create calendar invite once times are proposed.
Tom (eng): Yup — will spin them up. Staging URLs: https://staging.marketplace.redwood/partner/nimbus and https://staging.marketplace.redwood/partner/edgeworks.
Lena (PR): Visuals note: marketing needs a 1200x600 hero, partner logo in svg, and a 1-paragraph partner quote. Can design & legal signoff be ready by Thu?
Arjun (product): Localization: EU (DE/FR) and JP landing variants will be done after hero freeze. ETA for localized copy: Mon next week. Also adding two CTAs: "Try in Hosted" and "Request Dedicated".
Tom (eng): Quick deploy update — running the demo lambda that mints preview tenants. Please avoid heavy load during Wed rehearsal window.
deploy-bot: Staging deploy succeeded: commit 7f9a2c8 — all services green. (reaction :white_check_mark:)
Maya (partnerships): Draft run-of-show for the rehearsal:
• 10:00 - 10:05 intro + goals (Maya)
• 10:05 - 10:20 SI onboarding walkthrough (Diego)
• 10:20 - 10:35 provisioning + smoke test (Tom)
• 10:35 - 10:50 press embargo simulation (Lena)
• 10:50 - 11:00 postmortem & action items
Can everyone confirm availability for Wed 10:00 PT?
Arjun (product): Confirmed. I'll bring the landing toggles and demo data.
Lena (PR): Confirmed. I'll simulate embargo leaks and confirm messaging fallback.
Diego (solutions): Confirmed. I'll have SI runbook v1 in the shared folder by EOD Tue.
Tom (eng): Confirmed. Will add a short checklist for rollback and hotspot metrics to the rehearsal doc.
Maya (partnerships): Great — final task list from this thread:
- partner quote (Nimbus/EdgeWorks) -> owner: Maya / due Thu
- hero assets + logo svgs -> owner: Marketing / due Thu
- 2 staging tenants provisioned -> owner: Tom / due Tue AM
- SI runbook v1 -> owner: Diego / due Tue EOD
- Press release draft + embargo plan -> owner: Lena / due Fri
- Cutover rehearsal invite -> owner: Maya / due Mon EOD
If any blockers pop up drop them here or DM. :rocket:
